newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson in $200 million deal with Bellsouth.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson in $200 million deal with Bellsouth.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications company Ericsson SpA said Thursday it signed 1.55 billion-crown ($200 million) equipment supply deal with a subsidiary of BellSouth Corp.

Ericsson said the letter of intent it signed with Bellsouth Mobility Inc. calls for it to supply its D-Amps 1900 equipment to Bellsouth customers in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana and Mississippi.
The technology provides mobile telephone users with advanced functions like caller identification, security services and short messaging systems.
